description: Synthetic shopper feedback for demo, triage, and response-flow testing. These are not customer records.

feedback.message: Will this battery fit a Boosted Mini X, or is it only for the larger boards? I do not want to order the wrong pack.
The remote is showing as sold out. Is there a compatible replacement, or can I join a back-in-stock list?
Does this kit include everything needed for the install, or do I need to buy a separate pulley and tool? A parts list would help.

feedback.productTitle: Evolve GTR Series 2 Bamboo All Terrain
feedback.message: I made it to checkout but cannot see the shipping cost until after entering all of my information. Can you show an estimate for Canada first?

feedback.productTitle: Evolve GTR Series 2 Carbon Street (Choose your Wheels)
feedback.message: I am deciding between the Carbon Street and the Bamboo All Terrain. A comparison of range, weight, and the best use case would make this much easier.
Are the pulleys included with these wheels? I have a V2 board and need to know whether I also need a belt kit before placing the order.
The helmet looks good, but I cannot find a sizing chart. Please add head measurements so I can choose the right size with confidence.
I want to understand the return window and who pays return shipping before buying a board. I had to search several pages and still could not find a clear answer.

feedback.productTitle: Boosted Replacement Battery Pack for Rev Scooter
feedback.message: I came here specifically for a replacement Rev battery, but it is out of stock and there is no restock date. Please add a notification option or suggest an alternative.
On my phone, it is hard to tell which image is the front view and which is the rear view. A swipe gallery with image labels would help.

feedback.productTitle: Boosted Replacement Used Frame for Rev Scooter
feedback.message: This is listed as used. Can you show photos of the actual frame and describe any scratches, dents, or stripped threads before I buy it?
I added two sets of motor guards, but the cart does not make it clear whether the price is for one guard or a pair. Please make the quantity in the title more obvious.
Which Evolve models does this charger work with? The product title is broad, and I need to confirm it matches my GTR Series 2 battery.
The product selection is much better than other electric ride shops, but I would love a way to ask a quick pre-purchase question without sending a full email.
The backpack arrived quickly and the photos were accurate. The only thing I was missing was tracking information after the order shipped.
The page says this charger is discontinued and points to a newer one, but I cannot tell which version I should select for my board. The replacement link needs clearer compatibility details.
Does this bike arrive ready to ride, or should I expect assembly? Please list the tools and approximate setup time on the product page.
I searched for a Boosted Mini replacement deck and got several accessories before finding the deck. Search should prioritize exact product matches and in-stock items.
I like that small replacement parts and tools are available here. Showing a recommended maintenance bundle with belts, bearings, and a skate tool would make checkout easier.
I am buying a gift card, but the checkout does not explain when the recipient gets it or whether it can be used on sale items. That information should be visible before payment.
